description: Stories must describe what system DOES (behaviors), not what system IS (capabilities). Reject stories that describe capabilities like 'Exposes', 'Provides', 'Contains', 'Represents'.

content: Stories must describe what system DOES (behaviors), not what system IS (capabilities)
Transform capability language into action language
- Instead of 'Exposes Tools' → 'User invokes MCP tool, system routes to handler'
- Instead of 'Provides Server Interface' → 'System starts server, listens for requests'
- Instead of 'Contains Validation Logic' → 'System validates payment when user submits order'
- Instead of 'Represents Order' → 'System creates order from user input'
Don't use capability language that describes what system IS
- 'Exposes Tools' (capability - what tools? when? to whom? what happens?)
- 'Provides Server Interface' (capability - what interface? when? why?)
- 'Exposes X' → 'System makes X available when Y'
- 'Contains X' → 'System uses X to perform Y'
